name: tps5430-12v-to-5v-2a-reference
description: Schematic reference for a TI TPS5430DDA asynchronous buck stage. Component values start from TI's 12 V to 5 V reference application; this is not a PCB-release or hardware-validated design.

components.notes: TI SLVS632L; DDA HSOIC with exposed thermal pad. Footprint intentionally unassigned pending package CAD verification.

assumptions: The component values are initial values from TI's 12 V to 5 V application circuit, not a fully optimized 2 A design.
ENA is intentionally left floating as permitted by the TI datasheet; do not pull it to ground.
TPS5430 pin 2 and pin 3 are NC and receive explicit KiCad no-connect markers.
TPS5430 exposed DAP is represented as schematic pin 9 and tied to GND; confirm the exact land-pattern pad mapping against the selected package CAD before PCB work.
No vendor electrical model is integrated; SPICE and LTspice deliverables are deliberately excluded.
Exact footprints, capacitor technology and DC-bias derating, inductor saturation/RMS ratings, diode thermal rating, input transient envelope, thermal design, and bench validation remain open.
notes: Reference design only. Not approved for PCB release or hardware construction.

requirements.text: Convert nominal 12 V DC to nominal 5 V DC.
requirements.acceptance: VIN and OUT nets are present in the generated schematic.

requirements.text: Support a nominal 2 A output load.
requirements.acceptance: Reference power-stage values and 2 A target are documented; component stress and thermal validation remain open.

architecture.summary: Asynchronous buck converter using TPS5430DDA, catch diode, 15 µH inductor, input/output capacitors and feedback divider.
blocks: TPS5430 controller and integrated high-side switch

decisions.decision: Use TI TPS5430DDA with the manufacturer's 12 V to 5 V reference values as the schematic starting point.
decisions.rationale: The schematic is a datasheet-backed controller-level reference; it is not a simulated or validated implementation.

risks.risk: The DDA exposed pad schematic pin identifier is provisional until matched to the chosen package land pattern.
risks.mitigation: Keep PCB generation disabled and do not assign a footprint.
risks.verification: Compare the selected TI or vendor package CAD and land-pattern drawing before PCB work.

risks.risk: Passives are reference values, not finalized orderable parts with verified stress margins.
risks.mitigation: Select exact parts and check bias, RMS, saturation, thermal and tolerance ratings.
risks.verification: Complete component-level calculations against the finalized input/load/ambient envelope.

risks.risk: Thermal, loop stability, transient and EMI performance have not been validated.
risks.mitigation: Do not release for construction; plan simulation and bench tests.
risks.verification: Complete model correlation and measured bench test plan on a reviewed PCB revision.
